verses: What to Chu Lin takes his car? Hsia Nan is the leading star. Not for Chu Lin does he go; Hsia Nan 'tis who draws him so.
Oft his purpose to go there At the court he will declare:-- "Yoke for me my goodly team; I to-night in Chu will dream. With those colts my way I'll make, Morning meal at Chu to take."
